EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 411 April 2, 1973
CREATING A PRESIDENTIAL TASK FORCE FOR THE RECONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT
OF MINDANAO
WHEREAS, the armed insurrection in Mindanao that is currently being subdued by government military
forces has seriously disrupted peace and order in the area;
WHEREAS, as a result of such armed insurrection, substantial damage has been caused to lives and property
and business and economic activities have been dislocated;
WHEREAS, as a consequence, the national goal for the development of Mindanao has been set back and mere
government military operations to subdue lawless elements is obviously not adequate for the restoration of
peace and order and the promotion of economic development in the area;
WHEREAS, the restoration therein of peace and order and the national goal for the economic development of
Mindanao call for immediate reconstruction and rehabilitation operations by a special task force that shall
pool all government resources from its economic development, financial, welfare and health agencies as well
as its military units;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1, dated September 22,
1972, as amended do hereby create a Presidential Task Force for the Reconstruction and Development of
The Task Force shall be composed of the following:
The Executive Secretary - Chairman
The Secretary of Public Works Transportation & Communications - Member
The Secretary of Finance - Member
The Secretary of National Defense - Member
The Secretary of Social Welfare - Member
The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources - Member
The Secretary of Health - Member
The Director-General, National Economic Development Authority - Member
An Implementing Staff located and operating in the area that shall assist the Task Force is hereby designated
and shall be composed of the following:
Commanding Officer of the Fourth Military Area - Coordinator
Chairman, Mindanao Development Authority - Member
Governors, all provinces of Mindanao - Member
Presidential Regional Officers for Development (Mindanao) - Member
In pursuance of the aforementioned objectives, the Task Force shall undertake the following:
1. Immediate assessment of the damage wrought on private property and government facilities, services and
establishments,
2. Identify and mobilize all sources of funds and prepare an integrated plan necessary for the full
reconstruction and rehabilitation of Mindanao in the context of the national development program,
3. Restoration of peace and order by adequate military operations, apprehension of rebellious leaders and
followers and the implementation of a selective amnesty and rehabilitation program, and
4. Such other action that may be needed for the above objectives.
The Development Management Staff, the National Computer Center and the Infrastructure Operations Center
are hereby designated to act as Secretariat to the Task Force, with the Development Management Staff acting
as overall coordinator.
The Presidential Task Force, its Secretariat and Implementing Staff are hereby authorized and empowered to
call upon all departments, bureaus, agencies or instrumentalities of the government, including
government-owned and/or controlled corporations as well as the private sector, to give the necessary
cooperation and assistance for the successful prosecution and discharge of its functions.
Finally, the Task Force shall operate and continue to exercise its powers until such time as its designated tasks
are completed. A report of its accomplishments shall be submitted to the President within three (3) months
from the date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
